# The prose figure ledger.
#
# A transcript that disagrees with the tool is caught by the replay, and until
# this file existed a sentence that disagreed with the tool was caught by
# nothing. Each entry below stands for one figure written out in prose, beside
# one registered noun, at one line of one document, and it says what set the
# figure counts and what holds the figure to that set.
#
# The reach of the scan is the nouns registered here and nothing else. A figure
# standing beside a noun this file does not register is invisible, and nothing
# anywhere notices that a new countable noun has entered the documents. When
# you write a sentence counting something, either write it about a noun this
# file already registers or add the noun, because nothing will remind you.
#
# A `counts=` phrase is prose naming the set the figure counts, and it is never
# the literal `none`. Entries sharing a phrase must agree about the figure and
# about how the figure is held, so a shared sentinel would group unrelated
# figures together and redden a run over a collision rather than over a
# disagreement. A figure that counts nothing still stands for something, and
# the phrase says what it stands for.
#
# An entry carries `derives=` naming a derivation the checks compute, or
# `holds=` naming why no derivation reaches it. Four holdings are allowed, and
# they are not worth the same:
#
#   partitive   The figure counts a member or a subset rather than the set.
#               It requires a reason.
#   elsewhere   Another test in the tree holds the figure. The check proves
#               that the named test is declared and nothing more, so the
#               reason carries the claim that the test reads the document and
#               counts, and a person is the one who checked it.
#   unreachable The tree declares the set where this package cannot read it.
#               The check proves the named line carries the named identifier,
#               which points a reader at the declaration and holds nothing.
#               A figure of this class goes stale in silence when the set it
#               names grows, and two of the entries below sit in that state
#               today.
#   prose       The tree declares the set nowhere. It requires a reason.
#
# A noun line registers one countable noun for the scan and carries nothing
# else.

noun commands
noun fields
noun flags
noun groups
noun kinds
noun outcomes
noun settings
noun tools
noun verbs
